title: Zoning text change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Queens
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens, paired with a related zoning map change. Together the actions would allow an 11-story mixed-use building with about 84 apartments, including 21 income-restricted units, and ground-floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 and approved the measure with modifications.
